text:
Alex R.: quick async checkpoint for the runtime perf sprint — kernel shim, continuous-batching, and KV cache tweaks. TL;DR: a regression popped in canary that affects 2-token tail p99; root PR is #4523; need owners for canary rollout strategy + eviction tuning.
Priya S.: can you repro locally or in sandbox? what workloads show it? :eyes:
Alex R.: repro on sandbox with our small-chat workload. command I ran: `./bench -load=small-chat -concurrency=64 -seq=32` — p50 same, p99 +6ms on 2-token tail.
Sam T.: FYI I merged a microkernel shim change yesterday (branch: shim/opt-4523) — it changes attention kernel scheduling. I pushed a microbenchmark in CI: baseline -> 1.02x throughput, but different seq dist shows p99 impact.
Jamie L.: KV side: eviction threshold default was 0.18, we saw more thrashing under continuous-batch. Proposal config (quick):
```yaml
kv_cache:
  max_size_mb: 512
  eviction_threshold: 0.25
  prefetch_window_ms: 12
batching:
  max_batch_tokens: 2048
  batch_window_ms: 20
```
This increases hit ratio but may increase memory pressure.
Dana QA: I can run a 4h soak on sandbox with the new KV params and microkernel shim. Which metrics should I watch?
Noah PM: timeline check — we need a safe canary by EOD tomorrow or fallback. Gate on p99 tail and kv_hit_ratio.
Alex R.: key metrics: `kv_hit_ratio`, `batch_window_ms`, `opt/kernel_sched/latency_p99`, `tail_tokens_p99`. Also watch error spikes and OOMs.
Priya S.: can you paste the exact CI benchmark output? small snippet helps.
Sam T.: pasted CI snippet: `throughput: 1250 req/s -> 1275 req/s (+2%), p99: 18ms -> 24ms on tail cases` — logs attached in CI (link).
Jamie L.: rollback plan: revert shim PR and reduce eviction_threshold back to 0.18, or temporarily increase `batch_window_ms` to 30 to reduce micro-preemptions.
Dana QA: starting soak now (sandbox-3), running both old and new configs back-to-back. I'll post results in ~4h.
ci-bot: Canary deploy queued: canary-4523 -> lane alpha (1%), job id 98234.
Alex R.: action items: 1) Sam review + small perf patch (owner: Sam) 2) Jamie run KV tune soak and finalize config (owner: Jamie) 3) Dana run soak and validate signals (owner: Dana) 4) Priya validate canary repro and perf harness (owner: Priya) 5) Noah draft rollback messaging (owner: Noah).
Priya S.: I'll also add a short repro script to infra repo and link it here. pinging @Sam for test vectors.
Sam T.: will review #4523 and try a tighter kernel_sched clock tweak before EOD.
Noah PM: I'll prepare a short customer-facing note template (if we need to widen rollback).
Dana QA: initial soak: kv_hit_ratio dropped ~2% at 90m mark, no OOM so far. I'll post full numbers when done.
Jamie L.: if hit_ratio stays down, I'll try eviction_threshold=0.28 next iteration and re-run.
Alex R.: thanks all — keep updates here, if anything urgent ping `@eng-runtime` and I'll escalate. :thumbsup:
